# Image

<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

An image displays inside an app card. Use it to enhance messages, showcase content, or provide visual context. The image appears alongside other elements such as text, buttons, or fields.

## Example

![Example](/img/image-appcard.png)

## JSON example

```json
{
    "content": {
        "settings": {},
        "body": [
            {
                "type": "section",
                "layout": "horizontal",
                "sections": [
                    {
                        "type": "message",
                        "text": "This is a section block with image"
                    },
                    {
                        "type": "image",
                        "images": [
                            {
                                "image_url": "https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1425082661705-1834bfd09dca",
                                "alt_text": "img01",
                                "image_index": 0
                            }
                        ]
                    }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
}
```
